write.confirmUpdateBody: The previous version will not be kept.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lockOnNote: Locked with {{method}} · Locks as soon as you leave the app
settings.lockOffNote: Show a lock screen on launch. Turning it on also hides app previews and screenshots.
settings.reminderNote: Not sending notifications yet. Coming soon.

lock.blockedMessage: Too many attempts. Try again in a moment.

setup.chooseNote: You can change this later in Settings.
setup.disclaimer: The lock hides the screen. It does not encrypt the diary file itself.
setup.mismatch: That didn't match. Please set it again.
setup.hintTitle: A hint, in case you forget
setup.hintNote: Answer it and we'll show your {{method}} again.
setup.hintDisclaimer: Pick an answer nobody else would guess. Anyone who knows it can open the lock. Spacing and capitalization don't matter.
setup.abandonBody: If you leave now, the lock won't be turned on.

hint.title: Find it with your hint
hint.none: No hint is saved on this device.
hint.forgotAnswer: I don't remember the answer either
hint.wipeBody: If there's no way to unlock, this is all that's left. Every piece and photo will be gone.

questions.trip: What trip do you remember most?

errors.emptyDiary: An empty piece can't be saved.
errors.alreadyWritten: You already have a piece for that day. One per day.
errors.savedButUnreadable: The piece was saved but couldn't be read back.

notice.title: Notices
notice.emptyBody: Anything new will show up here.

support.title: Contact us
support.privacyNote: Your message, the email address you signed in with, your app version and device type are sent together. Your diary entries are not.
support.loginPrivacyNote: Signing in shares your Google account email address. We use it only to reply to your inquiry, and it is deleted when you delete your account.
support.failNotConfigured: We can't take messages right now. Please try again later.
support.failOffline: Connection looks unstable. Check your network and try again.
support.failRateLimited: Too many messages right now. Please try again shortly.
support.failError: Couldn't send. Please try again later.
support.loginRequiredBody: We need to know who you are so we can reply.
support.loginNotRequiredForDiary: Writing your diary never requires signing in.
support.failSignInAgain: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
support.signOutBody: Your diary stays on this device.
support.deleteBody: Your account and the sender details on your inquiries will be erased. This cannot be undone. The diary on this device is not deleted.
support.loginFailed: Couldn't sign in. Please try again in a moment.

backup.title: Backup
backup.lead: Your entries are encrypted before they leave this device, so you can get them back if you lose your phone.
backup.noticeUnreadable: Everything is locked on this device first. We cannot read your entries.
backup.noticeMetadata: The backup time and size are stored on the server.
backup.offBody: Backup is not turned on yet.
backup.codeUnconfirmed: You haven't confirmed your recovery code yet. Without it, your backup cannot be opened.
backup.codeBody: This code is the only way to open your backup on another device. Save it somewhere safe now.
backup.codeWarnLost: • If you lose this code, no one can open your backup — not even us.
backup.codeWarnShared: • Anyone who sees this code can open your backup from now on, and that cannot be undone.
backup.codeWarnWhere: • Keep it outside the Google account you sign in with. Paper or a separate password manager works well.
backup.confirmCodeWrong: That does not match. Please check what you saved.
backup.restoreCodeLead: Enter your recovery code. Spaces and hyphens do not matter.
backup.restoreUseThisDevice: Use the code stored on this device
backup.restoreNoLocalKey: There is no code stored on this device.
backup.restoreDoNotLeave: Please keep the app open until this finishes.
backup.restoreLosing: {{count}} entries that exist only on this device will be deleted
backup.restoreLosingBody: Restoring removes anything that is not in the backup. This cannot be undone.
backup.restoreNothingLost: Nothing on this device will be lost.
backup.restorePhotosNote: Photos are not restored yet. Photo slots will appear empty.
backup.restoreConfirmBody: {{count}} entries that exist only on this device will be deleted.
backup.restoreDoneBody: App lock is off. You can turn it back on in Settings.

fail.not-configured: The backup server is not configured.
fail.offline: You are not connected to the internet.
fail.no-grant: Another device is using this backup. Restore here first to take it over.
fail.quota-exceeded: You have run out of storage.
fail.no-vault: There is no backup to restore.
fail.seq-conflict: This does not match the server. Please try again shortly.
fail.vault-purged: The backup was deleted after the retention period.
fail.too-large: That is too large to upload at once.
fail.upstream: The server is having trouble. Please try again shortly.
fail.no-keys: There is no recovery code on this device.
fail.unreadable: This backup was made by a newer version. Please update the app.

backup.graceTitle: Your backup will be deleted in {{days}} days
backup.graceBody: It will be removed on {{date}}. Resubscribing before then keeps it.
backup.offGraceNotice: If your subscription ends, the backup is deleted after {{days}} days. This notice may not reach you unless you open the app.

subscribe.title: Jogak Pro
subscribe.lead: One subscription: no ads, and your entries kept safe.
subscribe.loginWhy: Linking the subscription to your account is what lets it follow you to a new phone.
subscribe.unavailable: Subscriptions are unavailable right now. Please check back shortly.
subscribe.restoredBody: Your subscription is linked to this account.
subscribe.restoreNoneBody: This Google account has no Jogak Pro subscription.
subscribe.doneBody: Ads are gone and backup is available.
subscribe.noEntitlement: The purchase went through but access has not been granted yet. Please reopen the app shortly.
subscribe.notReadyBody: Your account is still being linked. Please reopen this screen.
subscribe.trialNotice: • After the 7-day free trial you are charged automatically. Cancel during the trial and you are not billed.
subscribe.oneAccountNotice: • A subscription works on one account at a time. Signing in with a different Google account moves it there.
subscribe.cancelNotice: • Cancel or change plans in Play subscription settings.
